project.name: Gimle Ivaldi
project.description: The cluster designer's backend: a standalone local process (IvaldiMain) that stores Blueprint documents as flat JSON files and validates their rendered topology.yaml/bundle.yaml/manifest output against the real Hilmir and Mimir parsers -- the same TopologyParser/TopologyValidator/ BundleParser/ManifestParser a real hilmir up/deploy would run -- so a design is checked against the platform's own rules before anything is run. Driving a real local hilmir up/deploy is a later addition, once the console's own run-panel contract is settled. Deliberately unauthenticated and loopback-bound by default, the same posture gimle-saga already established, but -- unlike Saga -- meant to reach an operator or developer with no source checkout: it ships in gimle-dist (standalone archive and bundled into the platform archive), the same distribution posture as gimle-hilmir/gimle-cli, not gimle-saga's dev-tree-only one.
